title: Kite
tagline: No engine. Trade height for speed and hope the canyon agrees.
description: A glider, a canyon and a clock. Diving buys speed and spends altitude; thermals give some back if you can find them. The course never changes, so every run is against the last one — your best flight is kept as a ghost and flies it again beside you, which is a more honest opponent than a leaderboard.
author: HexCave
controls: A / D or left-right to bank
W / S or up-down to pitch
